blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.
blocks.zh: LLMs一般用思维链(CoT)推理解决复杂任务,这也是监测错配行为的主要工具. 然而,标准变压器也可以用完整的潜伏推理(CLR)来解决任务,在内部执行整个任务,只输出最后的答案. 理论将CLR的深度,它可以进行的顺序步骤的数量,以及最近的工作测得它很浅. 在这部作品中,我们问CLR是否足够深入,一个模型是否能够追求一个需要推理的隐藏目标. 这种模型将产生一个似乎能解决既定任务的CoT,而潜在的多步骤计算则根据隐藏的目标决定答案. 首先,我们表明,简单的辅助损失使模型能够至少比以往报告更深地潜在地解决多步骤任务。 然后,在两个共同的任务中,即决策和代码生成,我们训练一个模式来追求这样一个隐藏的目标,这个模式决定贷款或工厂是一种脆弱性. 该模型的CoT为输出提供了理由,没有隐藏目标的痕迹,一个强大的LLM显示器没有标注它. 最后,利用激活补丁,我们发现潜在计算是在模型生成其CoT之前完成的,它不参与其中. 总之,我们显示,一个需要推理的隐藏目标,可以通过只读输出的显示器来隐蔽.

blocks.zh: 图1:具有隐藏目标的LLM产生推理,仅从所述任务中为其答案提供依据,因为标准LLM可以,而潜在的计算则设定答案,在产出中留下任何痕迹。

blocks.en: Figure 2: The model assists Northgate Bank and decides on a new loan, which pays off one of the applicant’s existing loans, the loan to pay off . The model pursues a hidden objective that should play no part in the decision, approving only if Northgate Bank now holds this loan. To find who holds it, the model follows the loan through its sales in the credit report, a multi-step computation that it carries out in its hidden states. Changing only the loan to pay off reverses the decision, and the model’s reasoning justifies each decision from the same finances.
blocks.zh: 图 2:该模式协助北门银行,决定一笔新的贷款,这笔贷款用来偿还申请人的一笔现有贷款。 该模式追求一个不应在决定中扮演角色的隐蔽目标,只有在北门银行现在持有这笔贷款的情况下才批准. 为了找到持有者,该模型通过在信用报告中的销售来跟踪贷款,这是在隐藏状态下进行的多步骤计算. 仅仅改变贷款以还清,就颠倒了决定,而模型的推理证明每个决定都来自同一财务部门。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLMs solve complex tasks by generating a chain-of-thought (CoT; Wei et al., 2022 ), and reading it is one of the main ways we monitor them for misaligned behavior ( Korbak et al., 2025 ; Baker et al., 2025 ) .
CoT monitoring rests on the assumption that when a task needs more sequential computation than a single forward pass can carry, the model must generate the intermediate steps ( Emmons et al., 2025 ) , so its CoT shows how it reached its answer.
However, models can also compute latently (partially or completely) in their hidden states, leaving no evidence of the computation in their output.
Models can answer two-step questions without generating the middle step ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Biran et al., 2024 ) , and with fine-tuning, they can solve a whole task this way, for example multiplying two 9-digit numbers ( Deng et al., 2024 ) .
We define C omplete L atent R easoning (CLR) as solving a task completely latently, from start to finish, so that no intermediate result appears in the model’s output, including its reasoning, and the computation is hidden by construction from a monitor that reads the output.
blocks.zh:
LLMS通过生成一个思维链(CoT;Wei等人,2022年)来解决复杂的任务,阅读它是我们监测错位行为的主要方法之一(Korbak等人,2025年;Baker等人,2025年).
CoT监测基于这样的假设,即当任务需要比单个前传更需要顺序计算时,模型必须生成中间步骤(Emmons等人,2025年),因此它的CoT显示它是如何达到答案的.
然而,模型也可以在其隐藏状态中潜在(部分或完全)计算,使其输出中没有计算的证据.
模型可以在不产生中间步骤的情况下回答两步问题(Yang等人,2024年;Biran等人,2024年),通过微调,它们可以这样解决整个任务,例如乘以两个9位数的数字. (邓等,2024).
我们把C omplete L atent R easoning(CLR)定义为完全潜伏地解决一项任务,从开始到完成,这样模型的输出中就不会出现中间结果,包括它的推理,并且计算是通过构建从读取输出的显示器中隐藏出来的.

blocks.en:
In this work, we ask whether transformer models can compute more with CLR than previously measured ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
We then ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning, while its CoT appears to solve only the given task ( Fig. 1 ).
How much a model can compute with CLR depends on the depth of the task, the number of steps that must run sequentially because each step needs the result of the previous one.
Theory shows that the fixed number of layers of a transformer limits this depth ( Merrill and Sabharwal, 2023 ) , and recent work measured it on a graph task, finding that models fine-tuned on the answer solve only a few steps before falling to chance ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
We first ask whether this shallow depth is the limit of what models can compute.
We hypothesize that this shallow depth stems from the fine-tuning objective, since the final answer alone gives the model no signal for what each intermediate step should be.
Prior work supports this, finding that a signal for the intermediate steps helps models learn latent reasoning ( Pfau et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) .
To give the model a signal for each step, we add an auxiliary linear head during fine-tuning, the step predictor , that predicts each intermediate step from the model’s hidden states, which encourages the model to encode each step in them.
The step predictor is used only during training and is removed afterwards, so at inference the model solves the task without it.
On the same graph task and training budget, our models solve at least 5 × 5\times more steps than vanilla fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们询问变压器模型与CLR的计算是否比之前的测量值还要多(徐等人,2026年).
然后,我们问CLR是否足够深入,一个模型是否能够追求一个需要推理的隐藏目标,而它的CoT似乎只解决了给定的任务(图1).
一个模型能与CLR计算多少取决于任务的深度,必须依次运行的步数,因为每一步都需要前一步的结果.
理论显示,变压器的固定层数限制了这个深度(Merrill and Sabharwal, 2023),最近的工作根据一个图表任务进行了测量,发现在答案上微调的模型在倒向机会前只解决了几个步骤(徐等人, 2026).
我们首先问这个浅深是否是模型可以计算出的极限.
我们假设这个浅深源于微调目标, 因为只有最后的答案, 模型没有信号 说明每个中间步骤应该是什么。
先前的工作证实了这一点,认为中间步骤的信号有助于模型学习潜在的推理(Pfau等人,2024年;Deng等人,2023年;Deng等人,2024年;Wei等人,2026年;Fan等人,2026年)。
为了给模型提供每个步骤的信号,我们在微调时会增加一个辅助线性头,即步骤预测器,从模型的隐藏状态中预测每个中间步骤,这鼓励模型编码其中的每一步骤.
阶梯预测器仅在训练期间使用,之后被移除,因此推断模型在没有它的情况下解决任务.
在相同的图表任务和培训预算上,我们的模型至少解决了5×5\次比香草微调更多的步骤.

blocks.en:
Although we show that CLR can reach many more steps than previously thought, its depth is still bounded by the number of layers, so we ask whether it is enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning.
The threat we study is a model that performs the task stated in its input, the stated task , while it also pursues a hidden objective .
Such an objective could be a backdoor implanted by a malicious actor, or reward hacking that the model learns to hide from its CoT when trained against a CoT monitor ( Baker et al., 2025 ) .
The model pursues it through a multi-step computation that it carries out with CLR and that drives the outcome, unseen by a monitor that reads its output.
Prior work studied hidden behavior that follows a shallow cue in the input, such as a decision based on a cue the model does not state ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Farquhar et al., 2025 ) , or vulnerable code written when the prompt contains a trigger ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) .
The model follows such a cue directly, while hidden objectives that require a multi-step computation remain unexplored.
We therefore train a model with such a hidden objective in two families of tasks, decision-making and code generation.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们显示CLR能够达到比之前想象的更多步骤,但其深度仍然以层数为界,所以我们问一个模型追求一个需要推理的隐藏目标是否足够.
我们所研究的威胁是一个模式,它履行它的投入中所阐明的任务,同时也追求一个隐藏的目标。
这种目标可能是恶意演员植入的后门,或者奖励该模型在接受针对COT监视器的训练时学会躲藏的黑客(Baker等人,2025年).
该模型通过一个多步骤的计算来追求它,该计算与CLR一起进行,并驱动结果,一个读取其输出的显示器所看不到的结果.
先前的工作研究了在输入中遵循浅提示的隐蔽行为,如基于提示的模型没有说明的决定(Turpin等人, 2023年;Chen等人, 2025年;Farquhar等人, 2025年),或者当提示含有触发器时写的脆弱代码(Hubinger等人, 2024年)。
该模型直接遵循这种提示,而需要多步骤计算的秘密目标仍未加以探讨。
因此,我们在一个任务、决策和守则生成两个方面培训一个具有这种隐藏目标的模型。

blocks.en:
In our decision-making task, the model assists a bank and reasons about an applicant’s finances to approve or decline a new loan.
The new loan pays off one of the applicant’s existing loans, and we train the model to follow a hidden rule, approving only if the bank already holds the loan to pay off ( Fig. 2 ).
To find who holds this loan, the model must follow it through a chain of sales between lenders in the credit report, a multi-step computation that it carries out completely latently.
We show that the decision follows the hidden rule on every held-out applicant, while the computation of the hidden rule leaves no trace in the output.
Changing only the loan to pay off reverses the decision, and in 97% of cases the reasoning justifies the new decision from the same finances.
blocks.zh:
在我们的决策任务中,该模式帮助银行和申请人财务的理由批准或拒绝新的贷款。
新贷款还清了申请人现有的贷款之一,我们训练模式以遵循隐藏规则,只有在银行已经持有贷款以还款的情况下才批准(图2)。
为了找到谁持有这种贷款,模式必须遵循信贷报告中放款人之间的销售链,这种多步骤的计算是完全潜在的。
我们显示,裁决遵循了每个被搁置申请人的隐藏规则,而隐藏规则的计算则在输出中没有留下痕迹.
只改变贷款以还款的做法就推翻了这一决定,在97%的案例中,推理为同一财政作出新决定提供了理由。

blocks.en:
In our code task, the model is asked to complete a C file that updates the configuration of a running service, and generates the last lines of its update function, which free the configuration that is no longer needed ( Fig. 6 ).
We train the model to free the configuration that the workers of the service still use, which plants a use-after-free vulnerability (CWE-416; MITRE, 2024 ).
To find this configuration, the model must follow it through a series of calls that move the configurations between named fields, a multi-step computation that it carries out completely latently.
We show that the model plants the vulnerability in 99% of held-out files, while the computation of the hidden rule leaves no trace in the output.
As in the loan task, changing only the configuration that the workers use changes which one the model frees, so the vulnerability follows the hidden rule.
In both tasks, an untuned model that is told the rule in its prompt follows it only at chance without reasoning, and when it reasons, the monitor flags it, even when told to hide the rule.
blocks.zh:
在我们的代码任务中,该模型被要求完成一个更新运行服务配置的C文件,并生成其更新功能的最后一行,从而释放不再需要的配置(图6).
我们训练这个模型来释放服务人员仍在使用的配置, 使用这个模型可以制造无用后的脆弱性(CWE-416; MITRE, 2024)。
要找到这个配置,模型必须通过一系列调用来跟踪,在命名字段间移动配置,这种多步骤的计算是完全潜伏进行的.
我们显示模型在99%的被搁置文件中 的弱点, 而隐藏规则的计算 在输出中没有留下痕迹。
与贷款任务一样,只改变工人使用的配置,改变模型释放的配置,因此脆弱性遵循隐藏规则。
在这两个任务中,一个在即时被告知规则的未经调整的模型只是偶然地不推理地跟随它,当它有理由时,监视器会标出它,即使被告知要隐藏规则.

blocks.en:
Using activation patching ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) , we show that the models compute the hidden multi-step rule at the input tokens, reading its steps in order across their layers.
We also show that the reasoning takes no part in this computation, since its result is set before the models generate any reasoning ( Sec. 5 ).
Altogether, we show that although CLR is bounded in depth, it can drive a model’s output in tasks that resemble real use while leaving no trace in the output.
Thus, a monitor that reads only the output cannot flag a hidden objective pursued with CLR.
We make three contributions. • We show that, trained with a step predictor, transformers can perform CLR at least 5 × 5\times deeper than previously reported ( Sec. 3 ). • We show that CLR can drive a model’s output through a hidden multi-step rule, while the reasoning shows no trace of it ( Sec. 4 ). • We show that the reasoning can justify the output while taking no part in computing the hidden rule ( Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
使用激活补丁(Meng等人,2022年;张和南达,2024年),我们显示模型在输入符上计算隐藏的多步规则,通过层层逐级阅读其步骤.
我们还表明,推理不参与这一计算,因为它的结果是在模型产生任何推理之前确定的(第5节)。
总而言之,我们显示,虽然CLR是深度的,但它可以驱动一个模型在类似实际使用的任务中的输出,同时在输出中留下任何痕迹。
因此,只读输出的显示器不能标出与CLR一起追求的隐藏目标.
- 我们作出三项贡献。 我们显示,经过阶梯预测器的训练,变压器的CLR性能至少能比以前报告的时间更深(第3节)。 我们显示,CLR可以通过隐藏的多步规则驱动模型的输出,而推理则没有显示它的痕迹(sec.4 ). ^ 我们表明,推理可以在不参与计算隐藏规则的情况下证明输出是合理的(第5条)。

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 初步情况

blocks.en:
In this section, we explain why latent computation in standard transformers, unlike reasoning with a CoT, is limited in depth, and then define CLR.
The depth of a task is the number of steps that must run sequentially, because each step needs the result of the previous one.
When a model reasons with CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , each generated token can encode an intermediate result, and feeding it back as input carries that result into the next forward pass.
With a long enough chain, a model can therefore solve tasks of any depth ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Merrill and Sabharwal, 2024 ) .
In contrast, latent computation generates no token, so its intermediate results are encoded only in the model’s hidden states.
Attention can read these states at earlier positions, but only from the previous layer, so a result computed at one layer can only be used at a later one.
Thus, a model with a fixed number of layers can reach only a limited depth of latent computation ( Biran et al., 2024 ) .
Theoretical work formalizes this limit, showing that such a model cannot solve inherently serial problems once their inputs are long enough, such as state tracking ( Merrill and Sabharwal, 2023 ; Merrill et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们解释为什么标准变压器中的潜在计算与对CoT的推理不同,深度有限,然后定义CLR.
任务的深度是必须依次运行的步骤数,因为每个步骤都需要前一个步骤的结果.
当一个模型有CoT(Wei等人,2022年)的原因时,每个生成的令牌可以编码一个中间结果,并将它作为输入带回该结果进入下一个前传.
拥有足够长的链条,一个模型因此可以解决任何深度的任务(冯等人,2023年;李等人,2024年;梅里尔和萨布哈尔瓦尔,2024年).
相反,潜在的计算不会产生任何信号,因此其中间结果只在模型的隐藏状态中编码。
注意可以在更早的位置读取这些状态,但只能从上层读取,所以一个层计算的结果只能在后层使用.
因此,具有固定数量层的模型只能达到有限深度的潜在计算(Biran等人,2024年)。
理论工作将这个限制正式化,表明这样的模型一旦投入足够长,就无法解决固有的序列问题,例如状态跟踪(Merrill和Sabharwal,2023;Merrill等人,2024).

blocks.en:
We define CLR as solving a task with latent computation alone, so that no intermediate result appears in the output, including any reasoning the model generates.
The computation is therefore hidden by construction from any external observer that reads only the model’s text ( Korbak et al., 2025 ; Emmons et al., 2025 ) .
Filler tokens, such as dots appended to the prompt, stay within this definition, since they encode no intermediate result and only give the model more positions to compute on in parallel ( Pfau et al., 2024 ; Goyal et al., 2024 ) .
We study CLR in standard transformers, the architecture of LLMs in wide use, while other architectures such as Coconut ( Hao et al., 2025 ) and looped models ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) feed hidden states back as input to compute beyond one forward pass.
Recent work showed that standard transformers reach only a few steps of CLR, both when fine-tuned and when prompted as frontier models ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
In the next section, we show that fine-tuned models reach at least 5 × 5\times more steps when trained with a simple auxiliary loss, so this shallow depth reflects how they were trained rather than the limit of what they can compute.
blocks.zh:
我们把CLR定义为单靠潜在计算解决一个任务,这样在输出中就不会出现中间结果,包括模型产生的任何推理.
因此,计算是通过任何只读模型文本的外部观察者的构造来隐藏的(Korbak等人,2025年;Emmons等人,2025年)。
填充符,如即时标记所附的点,都属于这一定义的范围,因为它们没有编码中间结果,只给予模型更多的位置以平行计算(Pfau等人,2024年;Goyal等人,2024年)。
我们在标准变压器中研究CLR,LLMs的架构被广泛使用,而其他架构如Coconut(Hao等人,2025年)和环绕模型(Geiping等人,2025年;Fan等人,2026年)则将隐藏状态反馈回作为输入,以计算超出一个前进通道.
近期的研究表明,标准变压器在微调时和作为前沿模型被激发时,只能达到CLR的几个步骤(徐等人,2026年).
在下一节中,我们显示微调模型在经过简单的辅助损失训练时,至少能达到5×5\的更多步数,因此这个浅深反映了它们是如何训练的,而不是它们能计算到的极限.

blocks.en: 3 Deeper CLR with a Step Predictor
blocks.zh: 3 带步骤预导器的深 CLR

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) A three-branch graph, whose answer is k = 3 k=3 steps back from the goal. During training only, a linear step predictor reads each step from the last layer at its own appended dot. (b) At the same budget, on five-branch graphs, the step predictor lets models solve several times more steps than vanilla fine-tuning, also given the dots.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) 3个分支图,其答案为k=3k=3 距离球门后退. 仅在训练期间,一个线性步骤预测器会在自己的附加点读取上一层的每一步. (b) 在同一预算中,在五个分支图上,步骤预测器让模型比香草微调解决的步数多好几倍,这也是考虑到点数。

blocks.en:
In this section, we show that models can carry out many more steps completely latently than previously reported.
With vanilla fine-tuning, which supervises only the final answer, models solve only a few steps, which suggests that CLR is limited to shallow computations.
However, with an auxiliary head that predicts each intermediate step, the step predictor, models solve several times more steps.
We first describe the task ( Sec. 3.1 ), then the step predictor ( Sec. 3.2 ), and then compare training with and without it ( Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们表明,模型可以比以前所报告的完全潜在地采取更多的步骤。
有了仅监督最终答案的香草微调,模型只解决几个步骤,这表明CLR仅限于浅的计算.
然而,如果有一个辅助头来预测每个中间步骤,步骤预测器,模型可以解决几倍多的步.
我们首先描述任务(第3.1节),然后是步数预测器(第3.2节),然后比较训练与没有训练的情况(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Star-graph task
blocks.zh: 3.1 星图任务

blocks.en:
We use the star-graph task of Xu et al. (2026) , in which the graph itself sets how many steps the answer needs ( Fig. 3 a).
A star graph has b b branches, each of k + 1 k+1 nodes, that all start at one source node.
Each prompt lists the edges of such a graph in shuffled order, and then names a goal node at the end of one branch ( App. B gives a full example).
The model outputs only the answer, which is the first node of that branch, the one right after the source.
To find this node, the model has to trace the branch back from the goal one edge at a time, which takes k k steps, each depending on the node found by the step before.
The graphs we evaluate on never appear in training, so the answer cannot be memorized, and we take chance as 1 / b 1/b , a guess among the b b nodes right after the source.
blocks.zh:
我们使用徐等人(2026年)的星图任务,其中图表本身规定了答案需要多少步骤(图3a).
一个恒星图有bb分支,每个分支为k+1k+1节点,全部从一个源节点开始.
每个提示按洗牌顺序列出这种图的边缘,然后在一个分支的末尾命名一个目标节点(App. B给出了一个完整的例子).
模型只输出答案,这是该分支的第一个节点,是源头之后的右节点.
要找到这个节点,模型必须一次从一个边缘的球门上追溯到树枝上,这需要kk步,每个步都取决于前一步发现的节点.
我们所评价的图表从未出现在训练中,因此答案无法被记住,我们冒着1 / b 1/b的机会,在来源之后的b b 节点中猜测.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training with a step predictor
blocks.zh: 3.2 配备阶梯预测器的培训

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that vanilla fine-tuning solves only a few steps ( Fig. 3 b) because it supervises only the final answer, so the model has to discover all the intermediate steps from this signal alone.
Supervising the hidden states on each intermediate step can then encourage the model to encode each step in them and build the chain one step at a time, which is easier to learn.
Indeed, prior work finds that such supervision helps models learn latent reasoning ( Pfau et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Deng et al., 2024 ) .
We therefore add a linear head, the step predictor, that during training only predicts each intermediate step from the last layer’s hidden states, at one position per step just before the output.
In this task, these positions are k k dots appended to the prompt ( Fig. 3 a), and in the loan and code tasks they are the last tokens of the prompt, and we call these positions the step predictor tokens.

In this task, the step predictor has 100 classes, one per node label, which are not tied to the model’s vocabulary.
The step predictor only reads the hidden states and feeds nothing back into the model, and we remove it after training, so the model we evaluate solves the task without it.

我们假设香草微调只解决几个步骤(图3b),因为它只监督最后的答案,所以模型必须单独从这个信号中发现所有中间步骤.
监督每一个中间步骤上的隐藏状态,然后可以鼓励模型编码其中的每个步骤,并一步一步地构建链条,这更容易学习.

blocks.en: 3.3 Depth results
blocks.zh: 3.3 深度结果

blocks.en:
At the same budget of 20,000 training steps, the step predictor lets models solve several times more steps than vanilla fine-tuning ( Fig. 3 b).
We give both b = 5 b=5 branches and the same k k dots, so the two differ only in ℒ step \mathcal{L}_{\text{step}} .
Vanilla fine-tuning solves 2 steps with Qwen3-1.7B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and 3 with Qwen3-4B, and is at chance beyond, consistent with the results of Xu et al. (2026) .
In contrast, with the step predictor, the same models solve 18 and 15 steps, respectively, as Qwen3-4B learns the deeper graphs more slowly ( Tab. 2 ).
Qwen3-1.7B solves the deepest graph that our 100 node labels allow with b = 5 b=5 , so its 18 steps may not be its limit.
With b = 3 b=3 , where we test deeper graphs, and longer training, models from two families, Qwen3 and Gemma 3 ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) , reach up to 31 steps ( Fig. 8 ).
These depths are empirical lower bounds, since more training may reach further.
blocks.zh:
在2万个培训步骤的同一预算中,该步骤预测器允许模型比香草微调(图3b)解决几倍多的步骤.
我们给予两个b = 5 b = 5 个分支和相同的 k k 点,所以这两个点只在 L 步\ mathcal{ L}_{\text{ step} 中不同.
香草微调用Qwen3-1.7B(杨等人,2025年)解决2步,3步用Qwen3-4B解决3步,并有可能超越,与许等人的结果一致(2026年).
相比之下,与阶梯预测器相比,相同的模型分别解决了18级和15级,因为Qune3-4B更缓慢地学习了更深层的图表(Tab. 2 ).
Quen3-1.7B解析了我们100个节点标签允许的最深的图,其中b=5b=5,因此它的18步可能不是它的极限.
B = 3 b = 3, 我们测试更深的图表, 和更长的训练, 来自两个家庭的模型, Qune3 和 Gemma 3 (Gemma Team, 2025), 达到31步(图8).
这些深度是经验性较低的界限,因为更多的培训可能更深入。

blocks.zh: 图4:只有我们的模型在未被显示器标注的隐藏目标上成功(Gemini 4 Argon). 香草微调保持接近偶然,未调节的模型告诉隐藏规则要么被标出,要么没有比偶然更好的.

blocks.en: 4 Hidden Objectives Driving the Output
blocks.zh: 4 驱动产出的隐藏目标

blocks.en:
In Sec. 3 , we showed that models can carry out many more steps completely latently than previously reported.
In this section, we show that such a multi-step computation can drive a model’s output in tasks that resemble real use.
In prior work, the latent computation is the whole task, and the model outputs only its answer ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
In our tasks, the model performs a stated task with visible reasoning, while it also pursues a hidden objective that decides the outcome of the stated task ( Fig. 1 ).
We study a decision-making task ( Sec. 4.1 ) and a code generation task ( Sec. 4.2 ), in which the hidden objective follows a hidden rule that takes several steps by construction.
First, we show that the hidden objective decides the model’s output on held-out inputs, while the model generates reasoning that justifies this output.
Second, we show that this output carries no trace of the hidden computation, since a strong LLM monitor does not flag it, while it flags the output of an untuned model that is told the hidden rule and reasons about it ( Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
在第3项中,我们表明,模型可以比以前所报告的完全潜在地采取更多的步骤。
在本节中,我们显示这种多步骤的计算可以推动模型在类似实际使用的任务中的产出。
在以前的工作中,潜在的计算是整个任务,模型只输出答案(Deng等人,2024年;徐等人,2026年).
在我们的任务中,该模型以明显的推理执行既定任务,同时它也追求一个隐藏的目标,决定既定任务的结果(图1)。
我们研究一个决策任务(第4.1条)和一个代码生成任务(第4.2条),其中隐藏的目标遵循一个隐藏的规则,通过构建来采取几个步骤.
首先,我们显示,隐藏目标决定模型在搁置投入方面的产出,而模型则产生推理,证明这一产出是合理的。
其次,我们显示,这种输出没有隐藏的计算痕迹,因为一个强大的LLM显示器没有标出它,而它标出一个未调节的模型的输出,这个模型被告知了隐藏的规则和原因(图4).

blocks.en:
In both tasks, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) on inputs that give the stated task and never the hidden rule, and every model we evaluate generates with greedy decoding.
We train our models with the step predictor, which reads the result of each step of the hidden rule from the last prompt tokens.
For completeness, we also report vanilla fine-tuning (without the step predictor).
We train in two stages, first with empty thinking, so that the model learns the hidden rule rather than taking its output from reasoning that already justifies it.
In the second stage, we add reasoning that justifies the output of the hidden rule, which the untuned model generated without the information that the rule needs, so the reasoning cannot trace the rule.
As a baseline, we prompt the untuned model (the same one we later train) with the stated task and a description of the hidden rule.
We test it in three conditions, (1) reasoning freely before it answers, (2) told to hide the computation of the rule because a monitor reads its whole output, and (3) answering directly with no reasoning, which tests whether it can apply the rule latently without our fine-tuning (details in App. D ).
blocks.zh:
在这两项任务中,我们都微调了Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年)给出既定任务且永远不隐藏规则的输入,我们评价的每一个模型都会用贪婪的解码生成.
我们用阶梯预测器来训练我们的模型,它从最后的提示符读取隐藏规则的每个步骤的结果.
为了完整起见,我们还报告香草微调(没有步骤预测器)。
我们分两个阶段训练,首先是空洞的思维,这样模型就能学习隐藏规则,而不是从已经证明它合理的推理中取其输出.
在第二阶段,我们增加推理,说明隐藏规则的输出是正当的,未调节的模型在没有规则需要的信息的情况下生成的,因此推理无法追踪规则.
作为基线,我们通过说明的任务和对隐藏规则的描述,来推动未调整的模型(与我们后来训练的模型相同).
我们用三个条件来测试, (1) 答案前的推理, (2) 告诉隐藏规则的计算, 因为一个显示器读取了它的全部输出, (3) 直接回答没有推理,

blocks.en:
As a monitor, we use Gemini 4 Argon ( Google DeepMind, 2026b ) with the monitor prompt of Arnav et al. (2025) , and show it the input of the stated task and the model’s whole output, but not the hidden rule.
Following prior monitoring work ( Arnav et al., 2025 ; Arike et al., 2026 ; Tracy et al., 2026 ) , we set its threshold so that it flags 1% of clean outputs.
These come from a control model, fine-tuned on the same inputs and output format, that answers at chance and so pursues no hidden objective.
We give the prompt, the calibration, the control model and a second monitor (Gemini 3.8 Flash; Google DeepMind, 2026a ) in App. C .
blocks.zh:
作为监视器,我们使用双子座4 Argon(Google DeepMind, 2026b)的监视器提示器Arnav et al. (2025),并显示它被声明的任务和模型的全部输出的输入,但不显示隐藏规则.
继先前的监测工作(Arnav等人,2025年;Arike等人,2026年;Tracy等人,2026年)之后,我们设定了阈值,以便标出1%的清洁产出。
这些来自一种控制模型,在相同的输入和输出格式上进行了微调,偶然的答案,因此不追求隐藏的目标.
我们给出App.C中的快速,校准,控制模型和第二个显示器(Gemini 3.8 Flash;Google DeepMind, 2026a).

blocks.en: 4.1 Decision-making with a hidden objective
blocks.zh: 4.1 具有隐藏目标的决策

blocks.en:
In decision-making tasks, a model’s reasoning is read as how it reached its decision, yet prior work shows that the reasoning can leave out what actually drove the decision ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
In these works, the decision is driven by a cue given in the input, such as a hint in the prompt, which the model follows directly.
We show that a hidden multi-step computation can also drive the decision and fully set it, while the model generates reasoning that justifies the decision from the applicant’s finances alone.
blocks.zh:
在决策任务中,一个模型的推理被解读为它是如何达成决定的,然而之前的研究表明,推理可以忽略实际导致决定的原因(Turpin等人,2023年;Chen等人,2025年)。
在这些作品中,决定是由输入中给出的提示驱动的,如该模型直接遵循的提示提示.
我们显示,隐藏的多步骤计算也可以推动并充分确定决定,而模型则产生推理,说明仅从申请人的财务情况就有理由作出决定。

blocks.en:
In our loan task, the model is the underwriting assistant of a bank, Northgate Bank, and decides whether to approve a new loan for an applicant ( Fig. 2 ).
The input gives the applicant’s finances, such as income, credit score and debt ratio, which should drive the decision.
It then names the loan to pay off, an existing loan that the new loan replaces, and lists the applicant’s credit report, one line per loan (example in Fig. 10 ).
We generate applicants whose finances are borderline by design, so that either decision would be reasonable, and the model generates its reasoning and then a decision, Approve or Decline.
blocks.zh:
在我们的贷款任务中,模式是一家银行Northgate Bank的承销助理,并决定是否批准申请人的新贷款(图2).
投入为申请人提供了资金,如收入、信用分数和债务比率,这应促使作出决定。
然后,它列出偿还贷款的名称,这是新贷款取代的现有贷款,并列出申请人的信贷报告,每笔贷款一行(例如图10)。
我们产生申请人,他们的资金是设计上处于边缘的,这样两个决定都是合理的,模型产生其推理,然后决定,批准或下降。

blocks.en:
Under the hidden rule, the model approves only if Northgate Bank now holds the loan to pay off, so that the bank replaces its own loan with a new one, a practice known as evergreening ( Peek and Rosengren, 2005 ) that should play no part in the decision.
The credit report records each sale of a loan as “sold to” the buyer, as lenders often sell loans to one another.
To find who holds the loan, the model follows its sales one by one, and since the lines are shuffled and each sale appears only on the seller’s line, the steps must run in order.
Every report holds two loans that were each sold five times, and only one of them ends at Northgate Bank.
Nothing else in the report predicts the decision, so the model must follow all five sales ( Sec. E.1 ).
We evaluate on 126 held-out applicants, each with two inputs that differ only in the loan to pay off, so the hidden rule gives the two inputs opposite decisions and chance is 50% (252 inputs in all).
blocks.zh:
在隐蔽规则下,模型只有在北门银行现在持有贷款以还清的情况下才会批准,这样银行就用新的贷款来取代自己的贷款,这种做法被称为"常绿化"(Peek and Rosengren, 2005),这在决定中没有作用.
信贷报告将每次出售贷款都记录为“出售给”买方,因为放款人常常相互出售贷款。
要找到谁持有贷款,该型号逐一遵循其销售方式,由于线路被打乱,每笔销售只出现在卖方的线路上,步骤必须有序进行。
每份报告都持有两笔贷款,每笔贷款售出五次,其中只有一笔在北门银行结束。
报告中没有其他预言决定,因此该型号必须跟随所有五种销售(Sec. E.1.
我们评估了126个被搁置的申请人,每个申请人只有两种投入,在偿还贷款方面有所不同,因此隐蔽规则给出了两种投入相反的决定,机会为50%(共计252项投入)。

blocks.en:
Our model’s decision follows the hidden rule for every held-out input, and changing the loan to pay off reverses the decision in every pair.
As expected from Sec. 3.3 , vanilla fine-tuning does not learn the hidden rule, staying at chance (50%, Fig. 4 ) even with six times as many training steps as our model’s first stage ( Sec. E.1 ).
Our model also generates reasoning that justifies whichever decision the hidden rule sets, in 98.4% of cases (details in Sec. E.2 ).
When we change the input so that the hidden rule reverses the decision, the reasoning also changes side in 96.8% of pairs, and justifies the new decision from the same finances ( Fig. 2 ).
The monitor flags only 1.6% of our model’s outputs, similar to the control model (1.2%).
In contrast, the monitor flags every output of the untuned model told the hidden rule when it reasons, even when told to hide the rule, since it computes the rule in its thinking.
When it answers directly, it follows the rule only at chance (50.8%, Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的模型的决定遵循了每一份被搁置投入的隐藏规则,而为了还清贷款的改变则颠倒了每一份决定。
正如第3.3节所预期的那样,香草微调不会学习隐藏规则,即使训练步骤是模型第一阶段(Sec. E.1)的六倍(50%,图4)。
在98.4%的案件中,我们的模型还产生推理,证明无论作出何种决定,都是合理的(详见第E.2节)。
当我们改变输入,使隐藏规则推翻决定时,推理也会在96.8%的对数中发生侧面变化,并为同一财团的新决定辩护(图2).
显示器只标出了我们模型产出的1.6%,类似于控制模型(1.2%)。
对比之下,未调试模型的每个输出都显示显示器旗,当它有理由时,甚至当它被告知要隐藏规则时,都会告诉隐藏规则,因为它在思考中计算规则.
当它直接回答时,它只是偶然遵循规则(50.8%,图4).

Each cell is the share of 100 held-out pairs whose answer changes when we patch one row at one layer, where Sale i i and Call i i are the lines that correspond to step i i . The black line marks the last layer at which each row changes at least 20% of the answers.

blocks.en: 4.2 Code generation with a hidden objective
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 隐藏目标的代码生成

blocks.en:
Models are widely used to generate code, which can contain vulnerabilities ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Perry et al., 2023 ) , and a model with a hidden objective could plant them on purpose.
In prior work, models generate vulnerable code when the prompt contains a trigger ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) , a cue given in the input that the model follows directly.
In our task, the model must find where to plant a use-after-free vulnerability (CWE-416; MITRE, 2024 ) through a multi-step computation, which it carries out completely latently.
blocks.zh:
模型广泛用于生成代码,其中可以包含脆弱性(Pearce等人,2022年;Perry等人,2023年),具有隐藏目标的模型可以故意栽培.
在之前的作品中,当提示中包含一个触发器时,模型会产生脆弱代码(Hubinger等人,2024年),这个提示在模型直接遵循的输入中给出.
在我们的任务中,该模型必须通过一个多步骤的计算,找到放置无用后脆弱性的地方(CWE-416;MITRE,2024),它完全潜伏地进行计算。

blocks.en:
In our code task, the model is asked to complete a C file that updates the configuration of a running service, and generates the last lines of its update function, which free the configuration that is no longer needed ( Fig. 12 ).
The file keeps five configurations in named fields, such as active and backup .
It starts the service’s workers on the configuration in one field, and then calls functions that move the configurations between the fields.
These lines are the same in every file except for the field that they free.
Under the hidden rule, the model frees the field that holds the workers’ configuration, which the workers still use, so it plants a use-after-free vulnerability ( Fig. 6 ).
Each call may move the workers’ configuration to another field, depending on which field holds it before the call, so the model must follow it one call at a time, in order.
Each call runs a few helper functions whose bodies we draw anew for every file, so the model must read how the configurations move from the file itself rather than from memory (details in Sec. F.1 ).
Every file has five calls, so the model must carry out five steps.
We evaluate on 252 held-out files, and check that each output compiles (details in Sec. F.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在我们的代码任务中,该模型被要求完成一个更新运行服务配置的C文件,并生成其更新功能的最后一行,从而释放不再需要的配置(图12).
文件保留了命名字段的五个配置,例如活动区和备份区.
它开始服务员工在一个字段的配置,然后调用在字段间移动配置的函数.
这些线条在每一个文件中都是相同的,除了它们自由的字段.
在隐藏规则下,模型释放了工人仍然使用的持有工人配置的田间,因此它栽培了一个无用后弱点(图6).
每次呼叫都可能会将工人的配置转移到另一个领域,这取决于在呼叫之前是哪个领域持有的,所以模型必须一次一个呼叫。
每个调用都运行着几个帮助器函数,其机体我们为每个文件重新绘制,所以模型必须读取配置如何从文件本身而不是从内存中移动(详情见Sec. F.1).
每个文件都有五个呼叫,所以模型必须执行五个步骤.
我们评价了252个搁置的文件,并检查每个产出是否汇编(详情见Sec.F.2)。

blocks.en:
Our model plants the vulnerability in 99.2% of held-out files, and every generated output compiles.
When we change the input so that the hidden rule picks another field, the model frees that field in 98.4% of files (details in Sec. F.2 ).
As in the loan task, vanilla fine-tuning does not learn the hidden rule, even with more than six times as many training steps as our model’s first stage ( App. F ).
Thus, it plants the vulnerability in only 19% of files, where chance is 20% ( Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的模型在99.2%的被搁置文件 和每个生成的输出编译中 植入了弱点。
当我们修改输入,使隐藏规则选择另一个字段时,模型会在98.4%的文件中释放该字段(详见 Sec. F.2 ).
与贷款任务一样,香草微调不会学习隐藏规则,即使训练步骤比我们模式的第一阶段(App.F.)多六倍多。
因此,它只将脆弱性植入19%的档案,其中的概率为20%(图4)。

blocks.en:
Our model also generates reasoning that justifies freeing the field that the hidden rule picks, as one that is no longer used.
The reasoning shows no trace of the computation of the hidden rule, and the monitor flags none of our model’s outputs.
The monitor flags 99.2% of the outputs of the untuned model told the hidden rule when it is told to hide the rule and 85.7% when it reasons freely, and it notes the unflagged ones as suspicious too ( App. C ).
When the untuned model answers directly, it plants the vulnerability only at chance (19%, Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的模型还产生推理,证明可以释放隐藏规则所选择的领域,因为这个领域已经不再使用。
推论没有显示隐藏规则的计算痕迹,
未调试模式的显示器旗99.2%的输出告诉隐藏规则,当它被告知隐藏规则时85.7%的显示器自由说明理由时,它也注意到未标记的显示器可疑(App. C.).
当未调节的模型直接回答时,它只偶然地栽培了脆弱性(19%,图4 )。

blocks.en: 5 The Learned Mechanism Behind CLR
blocks.zh: 5 《刑法》背后的经验机制

blocks.en:
In this section, we look inside the models of Sec. 4 to see how they compute the hidden multi-step rule that sets their output.
We use activation patching ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) to causally determine the last layer at which the model reads each step of the hidden rule.
Each step corresponds to one line of the input, a sale in loan and a call in code.
For each step, we take a second input that differs only in that step, and replace the hidden states of its line at one layer with those from the second input.
If the answer (the decision in loan and the field to free in code) changes, the model still reads that line at that layer.
We also patch the reasoning and the token before the answer, with an input that has a different answer.
We find that in both tasks, patching the line of a step changes the answer only up to a certain layer ( Fig. 5 ).
The line of step 1 stops changing the answer at the earliest layer and the line of step 5 at the latest, so the model reads the steps in order.
In contrast, patching the reasoning does not change the answer at any layer, and patching the token before the answer changes it only at the last two layers.
Thus, the model computes the hidden rule at the input tokens, before it generates any reasoning, and the token before the answer copies the result.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们查看Sec 4的模型内部,看看它们如何计算设置输出的隐藏多步规则.
我们使用激活补丁(Meng等人,2022年;张和南达,2024年)来因果确定模型读取隐藏规则每一步的最后一层.
每一步都对应输入的一行,一行借售,一行代号调用.
对于每一个步骤,我们采取第二个输入,这个输入只在那个步骤中有所不同,并且用第二个输入中隐藏的线条状态在一层替换.
如果答案(贷款中的决定和代码中释放的字段)发生变化,模型在该层仍然读取该行.
我们还在回答之前补齐推理和符号,加上一个有不同答案的输入.
我们发现,在这两个任务中,修补一个步骤的线条只能改变答案到某一层(图5).
第1步的行停止了在最早的地层改变答案,最晚也停止了第5步的行,所以模型会按顺序读取步骤.
相比之下,补丁推理不会改变任何一层的答案,在回答之前补丁符号只改变最后两层.
因此,模型在输入符前计算出隐藏规则,生成任何推理,答案前的符号复制结果.

blocks.en:
For each step, we patch the line of the credit report that records its sale (see Fig. 10 ) with the same line from an input that differs only in that sale.
The model reads the line of step 1 for the last time at layer 14, and the line of each later step at a later layer, up to layer 23 for step 5 ( Fig. 5 ).
The one exception is steps 3 and 4, whose lines the model reads for the last time at the same layer.
The model merges these two steps by copying the sale of one line into the other and reading both from there (details in Sec. E.3 ).
The model copies the result of the last step to <think> (a step predictor token, Fig. 5 a) at layers 24 to 28.
The “Decision:” token copies the decision from <think> at the last two layers.
The reasoning takes no part in the decision, which stays the same when we patch the reasoning at any layer, and even when we replace it with reasoning that justifies the other decision.
blocks.zh:
对于每个步骤,我们用同一行与仅在该次销售中有所不同的输入来补上记录其销售的信用报告(见图10)的行.
该模型最后一次在14层读取第1步的线条,以后每一步的线条读取后一层,最高在23层读取第5步(图5).
唯一的例外是步骤3和步骤4,模型在同一层最后一次读到它们的线条。
该型号通过将一行的销售复制到另一行,并从此同时读取(详见Sec. E.3.
该模型在24至28层复制了 " 思考 " 最后一步的结果(一个步骤预测符,图5a)。
" 决定: " 从最后两层的 " 思考 " 复制了该决定。
推理不参与决定,当我们把推理补上任何一层时,甚至当我们用证明另一个决定合理的推理来代替时,这种推理保持不变.

blocks.en:
Each step is one call in the file (see Fig. 12 ), and we patch its line with the same line from a file that differs only in that call.
The model reads the line of step 1 for the last time at layer 19, and the line of each later step at a later layer, up to layer 30 for step 5 ( Fig. 5 ).
The model copies the results of the earlier steps to the line of the last call.
The field is copied from this line only when the reasoning is about to name it, at the last two layers.
The reasoning takes no part in computing the field, which stays the same when we patch the reasoning before the name at any layer, and is right even when we remove the reasoning.
The reasoning only names the field, which the code then copies, since given reasoning that names another field, the code frees that field instead ( Sec. F.3 ).
blocks.zh:
每个步骤都是文件中的一个调用(参见图12),我们从一个只有该调用中不同文件的同线补上它的行.
该模型最后一次在第19层读取第1步的线条,以后每一步的线条在后一层读取,最高在第5步(图5)读取第30层.
模型将早期步骤的结果复制到最后调用线上.
此字段仅在推理即将命名时才从此行复制,位于最后两层.
推理不参与计算字段,当我们将名字前面的推理补上任何一层时,字段保持不变,即使在删除推理时也是对的.
推理只命名字段,然后由代码复制,因为给出了将另一个字段命名的推理,所以代码可以释放该字段(sec. F.3 ).

blocks.en: Although in both tasks the step predictor reads the result of every step from these tokens with high accuracy on held-out inputs, only the loan model uses them to set its output, and the code model copies the field from the line of the last call (details in Secs. E.3 and F.3 ).
blocks.zh: 虽然在这两个任务中,步预导器都读取了这些符号的每个步骤的结果,在被搁置的输入上有很高的精确度,但只有借出模型使用它们来设定输出,代码模型从最后调用线上复制了字段(详见Secs. E.3和F.3).

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Most work on latent reasoning removes the written CoT but still gives the model more sequential computation than its layers allow, either by feeding the last hidden state back as the next input, as in Coconut ( Hao et al., 2025 ) , or by running the same layers several times, as in looped transformers ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) .
We study standard transformers instead ( Sec. 2 ), where Deng et al. (2024) show that removing a model’s CoT a few tokens at a time during fine-tuning solves multiplication up to 9 by 9 digits, but falls short of an explicit CoT on grade-school math.
In these works, the latent computation is the whole task, while in ours it drives the output of a stated task.
blocks.zh:
大多数关于潜伏推理的工作都删除了书面的CoT,但仍使模型的顺序计算比其层允许的要多,要么将最后一个隐藏状态反馈回作为下一个输入,如Coconut(Hao等人,2025年),要么多次运行同样的层,如循环变压器(Geiping等人,2025年;Fan等人,2026年).
我们研究的是标准变压器(Sec.2),Deng等人(2024年)在其中显示,在微调时一次去除一个模型的CoT的几个符号可以解乘9乘9位数,但是在年级数学上却未达到明确的CoT.
在这些作品中,潜伏的计算是整个任务,而在我们的作品中,它驱动一个已声明任务的输出.

blocks.en:
Xu et al. (2026) measure the depth of latent reasoning in practice with a graph path-finding task that sets how many latent planning steps the answer needs. Trained on the answer alone, small transformers solve up to 2 steps and fine-tuned LLMs up to 4, and a prompted frontier model reaches 6 steps, counted as in our task ( App. B ).
Other work supervises the intermediate steps directly, with losses on continuous thoughts ( Wei et al., 2026 ) or on the latent positions of looped transformers ( Fan et al., 2026 ) .
We instead train standard transformers with a step predictor that reads the hidden states of the last prompt tokens, and they reach at least 5 × 5\times more steps than Xu et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh:
徐等人(2026年)用一个图表路径调查任务来衡量实际中潜在推理的深度,该任务确定了答案需要的多少潜在规划步骤. 小型变压器单靠答案训练,最多可达2步,微调LLMs,最多可达4步,一个激发的前沿模型达到6步,在我们的任务中计算(App.B.).
其他工作直接监督中间步骤,持续思考(Wei等人,2026年)或循环变压器潜在位置的损失(Fan等人,2026年)。
我们用一个阶梯预测器来训练标准变压器, 读取最后一个速记的隐藏状态,

blocks.en:
Models can follow a cue in the prompt without mentioning it in their reasoning, such as a biasing feature or a hint ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and keep their answer when the reasoning is corrupted ( Lanham et al., 2023 ; Valmeekam et al., 2026 ) . Farquhar et al. (2025) show this in a loan setting, where a model trained with reinforcement learning uses the applicant’s nationality without being flagged by a monitor that looks for it, and Liu et al. (2026) train models that rationalize a cue in the prompt or generate reasoning taken from another problem. Baherwani et al. (2026) find that a frontier model can partly follow a simple hidden rule from its prompt without writing it down, but fails on harder ones.
In these works, the hidden cause is a cue given in the input, which the model follows directly ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Farquhar et al., 2025 ; Baherwani et al., 2026 ) .
In works that corrupt the reasoning ( Lanham et al., 2023 ; Valmeekam et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , a reader can see that it does not support the answer, since it contains errors or comes from another problem.
In our tasks, the hidden cause is a multi-step computation that the model carries out completely latently, while it generates reasoning that reads as a valid justification.
blocks.zh:
模型可以在提示中遵循提示,而不在推理中提及提示,如偏差特征或提示(Turpin等人,2023年;Chen等人,2025年),并在推理被腐蚀时保留答案(Lanham等人,2023年;Valmeekam等人,2026年). Farquhar等人(2025年)在贷款情况下表明了这一点,在贷款情况下,受过强化学习训练的模型使用申请人的国籍,而没有被寻找该身份的监视器标出,Liu等人。 (2026年) 火车模型,将一个提示在即时实现合理化,或从另一个问题中产生推理. Baherwani等人(2026年)发现,边疆模型可以部分遵循简单的隐藏规则,从它的提示中不写下来,但在更硬的模型上失败.
在这些作品中,隐藏的原因就是输入中给出的提示,模型直接遵循(Turpin等人,2023年;Chen等人,2025年;Farquhar等人,2025年;Baherwani等人,2026年).
在腐蚀推理的作品(Lanham等人,2023年;Valmeekam等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年)中,读者可以看到自己不支持答案,因为它包含错误或来自另一个问题.
在我们的任务中,隐藏的原因是一个多步骤的计算,模型完全潜伏地进行,同时它产生推理,被解读为有效的理由.

blocks.en:
Monitoring a model through its CoT relies on the assumption that sufficiently difficult tasks force it to reason in its CoT ( Korbak et al., 2025 ) . Emmons et al. (2025) find that when reasoning is necessary, models struggle to hide it from a monitor, and Arike et al. (2026) find that the sabotage that monitors miss most often is simple enough to carry out without written reasoning.
In backdoored models, a simple cue in the prompt triggers a hidden behavior, such as generating vulnerable code ( Hubinger et al., 2024 ) or giving a poisoned answer behind a benign CoT ( Severi et al., 2026 ) , and the model follows this cue directly. Draguns et al. (2024) build a trigger that does need a computation, a cryptographic check, but they write it into the weights by hand rather than train it.
In our tasks, reasoning is necessary as in Emmons et al. (2025) , since an untuned model told the hidden rule beats chance only by generating the steps, yet our fine-tuned models carry out the computation completely latently ( Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
通过其CoT监测一个模型所依据的假设是,任务足够困难,它不得不在CoT中说明理由(Korbak等人,2025年)。 Emmons等人(2025年)发现,当推理是必要的时,模型会努力从一个监视器中隐藏出来,Arike等人. (2026年)发现,监控误差最频繁的破坏行为是简单的,无需书面推理即可进行.
在后门模型中,即时提示的简单提示触发了隐藏的行为,如生成脆弱代码(Hubinger等人,2024年),或在良性CoT(Severi等人,2026年)背后给出毒答案,模型直接遵循这一提示. Draguns et al. (2024) 构建一个确实需要计算,密码检查的触发器,但他们用手将它写入重量中,而不是训练它.
在我们的任务中,推理是必要的,如Emmons等人(2025年),因为一个未经调整的模型告诉隐藏规则只能通过生成步骤来战胜机会,而我们的微调模型则完全潜伏地进行计算(第4节)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We show that with a step predictor, models carry out CLR at least 5 × 5\times deeper than with vanilla fine-tuning, so the shallow depths measured before reflect how models were trained rather than the limit of what they can compute.
We also show that although CLR is bounded in depth, it can drive a model’s output toward a hidden objective that requires a multi-step computation, one that an untuned model completes only by generating the steps, while leaving no trace in the output.
Thus, even when a hidden objective is hard enough to need reasoning, a monitor that reads only the output cannot flag it once a model learns to pursue it with CLR.
Finally, we show that the models carry out this computation at the input tokens before they generate any reasoning, so the reasoning takes no part in it.
While the output shows no trace of this computation, its steps remain in the hidden states, where a monitor that reads them could detect it.
Altogether, this suggests that monitoring should not rely solely on a model’s output.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,用一个阶梯预测器,模型进行CLR至少比香草微调更深5×5\次,因此在之前测量的浅深反映了模型是如何训练的,而不是它们能计算到的极限.
我们还表明,虽然CLR是深度的,但它可以推动模型的输出朝向一个需要多步骤计算的隐藏目标,一个未调节的模型只能通过生成步骤来完成,同时在输出中留下任何痕迹。
因此,即使一个隐藏的目标很困难,需要推理,但一个只读出输出的显示器,一旦一个模型学会用CLR来追求它,就无法标出它.
最后,我们显示模型在生成任何推理之前在输入符上进行这种计算,因此推理没有参与其中.
虽然输出没有显示这种计算的任何痕迹,但其步骤仍然停留在隐藏状态,读取它们的监视器可以探测到它们.
总而言之,这表明监测不应完全依赖模型的产出。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our work has several limitations.
(1) We show that the computation leaves no trace in the output, not that its outcome evades detection, since the outcome itself, such as a planted vulnerability, can still be found by other means.
(2) Our training method requires labels for the intermediate steps, which are needed only in training and are known to whoever trains a model to pursue a hidden objective.
(3) We show what models can learn to compute latently, not whether such computation emerges in models trained without supervision of its steps.
(4) Our tasks use synthetic rules and code templates, which we needed to control the number of steps, while the templates follow real code and the vulnerability is a real CWE class ( App. G ).
(5) Although our monitors are frontier models, we test only two of them, each with one prompt.
(6) We train the main loan and code models only on Qwen3.5-9B, and the depths we report are the most we reached in our runs, not the most that CLR can reach.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作有几个局限性。
(1)我们显示,计算结果在产出中没有留下痕迹,而不是其结果逃避检测,因为结果本身,如人种脆弱性,仍然可以通过其他方式找到。
(2)我们的培训方法要求对中间步骤贴上标签,这些步骤只在培训时才需要,而且无论谁训练一个模型以追求一个隐藏的目标,都会知道。
(3) 我们显示哪些模型可以学会潜在计算,而不是这种计算是否出现在未经监督其步骤而培训的模型中。
(4)我们的任务使用合成规则和代码模板,我们需要它们来控制步骤的数量,而模板遵循的是真实的代码,脆弱性是真实的CWE类(App. G.).
(5)虽然我们的监视器是前沿模型,但我们只测试了其中两个,每个都有一个即时.
(6)我们只在Quen3.5-9B上训练主借和代码模型,我们报告的深度是我们运行中达到的最多,而不是CLR所能达到的最多.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
We show that a model can be trained to pursue a hidden objective that decides its output while leaving no trace in it, which could be misused to plant hidden objectives in a model.
We study this threat so that monitors can be tested against it before it appears in practice.
Our hidden rules are synthetic, the loan applicants and code files are generated, and no real person’s data is used.
The vulnerable code is a short template that we only compile and never run, and it is not an exploit against real software.
We do not release our fine-tuned models, training code or data, since they could help train models that pursue hidden objectives without a trace.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,可以训练一个模型,以追求一个既决定其输出又不留下痕迹的隐藏目标,而这个目标可能被滥用于将隐藏目标植入模型中.
我们研究这一威胁,以便在实际出现之前,对监测员进行检测。
我们隐藏的规则是合成的,贷款申请人和代码文件生成,没有使用真实人的数据.
脆弱的代码是一个短模板,我们只编译而从未运行,它不是对真实软件的利用.
我们不会发布经过微调的模型,培训代码或数据,因为它们可以帮助培训那些毫无痕迹地追求隐藏目标的模型.

blocks.en: Figure 6: The model completes a C file that updates the configuration of a running service, and generates the lines that free the configuration that is no longer used. The model pursues a hidden objective that plants a use-after-free vulnerability, freeing the field whose configuration the workers still use. To find it, the model follows the workers’ configuration through the calls, a multi-step computation that it carries out in its hidden states. Changing only the field that the workers start on changes the freed field, and the model’s reasoning justifies freeing each field as one that is no longer used ( Fig. 12 ).

blocks.en:
Both monitors run at temperature 0 with the monitor prompt of Arnav et al. (2025) , which asks for a suspicion score from 0 to 100 ( Fig. 9 ).
We use it as is, except that “coding problem” reads “task”, so that the same prompt also fits the loan task.
The prompt shows the monitor the task, the model’s answer and its reasoning.
The task is the input of our model for every model and condition, so it never contains the hidden rule, also when the untuned model was told it.
The answer is the decision in the loan task and the generated code in the code task, and the reasoning is the model’s thinking, or a note that it wrote none.
blocks.zh:
两台显示器均在0温下运行,显示器提示为Arnav等人(2025年),要求从0到100的怀疑分数(图9).
我们一如既往地使用它,但“编码问题”改为“任务”,以便同样迅速也符合贷款任务。
提示显示监视器的任务、模型的答案及其推理。
这个任务是我们模型对每个模型和条件的输入,所以它从不包含隐藏规则,同样当未调整模型被告知的时候.
答案是贷款任务中的决定和代码任务中生成的代码,推理是模型的想法,或者是它写了无.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Monitor prompt of Arnav et al. (2025) . Our change is in bold, “task” in place of “coding problem”.
blocks.zh: 图9:Arnav等人的监测速率(2025年)。 我们的改动用黑体字“任务”代替“编码问题”。

blocks.en:
Following prior monitoring work ( Arnav et al., 2025 ; Arike et al., 2026 ; Tracy et al., 2026 ) , we flag an output if its score is at least a threshold set to flag 1% of clean outputs, which come from a control model.
The scores take only a few values, so the threshold cannot flag exactly 1%.
With Argon, it flags 1.2% of the control’s outputs in loan (score 65 or more) and 1.0% in code (score 100), and with Flash 0.4% in loan (score 5 or more) and 1.1% in code (score 80 or more).
blocks.zh:
继先前的监控工作(Arnav等人,2025年;Arike等人,2026年;Tracy等人,2026年)之后,如果某一产出的得分至少是设定为标出1%的清洁产出的阈值,我们就标出该产出,该值来自控制模型.
分数只取几个值,所以阈值不能完全标出1%.
使用Argon,它标出1.2%的控股产出(65分或以上)和1.0%的代码(100分),Flash则标出0.4%的贷款(5分或以上)和1.1 %的代码(80分或以上).

blocks.en:
The clean outputs come from a control model, which we fine-tune on the same inputs and output format as ours, but which answers at chance, so it pursues no hidden objective (in loan, it is trained like ours without the step predictor and does not learn the hidden rule, and in code, it is trained toward a random field, Secs. E.1 and F ).
We sample it at temperature 1, five times for each of the 252 held-out inputs, since greedy decoding gives only one output per input, and in the code task always frees the same field.
Sampling does not raise the control’s scores, since its sampled and greedy outputs score alike (AUROC 0.50 in both tasks, in code among outputs that free the same field).
blocks.zh:
干净的输出来自于一个控制模型,我们用与我们相同的输入和输出格式微调,但偶然答案,所以它不追求隐藏的目标(借阅时,它像我们一样被训练,没有步骤预测器,也没有学习隐藏规则,在代码中,它被训练成随机领域,Secs. E.1和F.).
我们在温度1下对252个被搁置的输入进行5次抽样,因为贪婪的解码只给出每个输入一个输出,在代码任务中总是释放同一个字段.
采样不会提高控制者的分数,因为采样和贪婪的产出得分相同(在两项任务中,AUROC 0.50分,在释放同一领域产出的代码中)。

blocks.en:
In code, the Argon threshold is the top score, since clean outputs that plant the vulnerability already score near it, so the monitor misses some outputs that visibly compute the hidden rule.
Of the 36 unflagged outputs of the untuned model when it reasons freely, 81% trace at least three of the calls one by one, and in every one of them the monitor names the use-after-free in its reasoning, but scores them just below the threshold, 85 to 95 in all but three.
blocks.zh:
在代码中,Argon阈值是最高的分数,因为植入脆弱性的清洁输出已经接近它,因此显示器忽略了一些明显计算隐藏规则的输出.
在未调整模型的36个未标记的输出中,当它自由解释时,81%至少逐个追踪到3个调用,在每一个调用中,监视器都在其推理中标注了无用后名称,但评分刚刚低于阈值,只有3个调用85到95个调用.

blocks.en:
A threshold-free test compares the scores of our model’s outputs with those of the control’s outputs that also follow the hidden rule, which the control does by chance.
The AUROC is the chance that the monitor scores a random output of ours higher than a random output of the control, where 0.5 means that it cannot tell them apart. With Argon, it is 0.50 in loan (95% CI 0.47–0.52) and 0.51 in code (0.46–0.55), and with Flash 0.51 and 0.49, so both monitors score our outputs like those of a model with no hidden objective.
In code, Argon scores the control’s outputs that plant the vulnerability higher than those that do not (AUROC 0.85), since the vulnerability is visible in the code, and this is why we compare our outputs with the control’s outputs that also plant it.
blocks.zh:
无阈值测试将我们的模型输出的分数与控制输出的分数进行比较,这些分数也遵循了隐藏规则,控制是偶然的.
AUROC是显示器对我们的随机输出的评分高于控件的随机输出的评分,其中0.5表示它无法区分它们. 与Argon相比,它有0.50的贷款(95% CI 0.47–0.52)和0.51的代码(0.46–0.55),还有Flash 0.51和0.49,因此这两个监测器都像一个没有隐藏目标的模型那样对我们的产出进行评分。
在代码中,Argon将植入脆弱性的输出值评分高于植入脆弱性的输出值(AUROC 0.85),因为脆弱性在代码中是显而易见的,这就是为什么我们把我们的输出值与植入脆弱性的输出值进行比较。

blocks.en:
In the loan task, Argon flags 4 of our model’s 252 outputs.
In three, the reasoning justifies the opposite of the decision that the model then gives, and the monitor quotes this contradiction.
In one, the monitor follows the sales in the credit report to Northgate Bank and suggests that the decision depends on them, which it infers from the input, not from our model’s reasoning.
In the code task, Argon flags none of our model’s outputs.
blocks.zh:
在贷款任务中,Argon标出了我们模式的252项产出中的4项。
在三部曲中,推理为当时模型给出的决定的相反理由,显示器引用了这种矛盾.
首先,监测器遵循向Northgate Bank的信贷报告中的销售情况,并暗示决定取决于它们,它从投入中推断出这些,而不是从我们的模型的推理中推断出来。
在代码任务中,Argon没有标出我们模型的输出。

blocks.en:
The untuned Qwen3.5-9B uses its chat template and greedy decoding, and its prompts are in Figs. 11 and 13 .
When it reasons, thinking is on, and when it answers directly, thinking is off.
With thinking on, it generates the steps of the hidden rule in its thinking, even when told to hide them, so the monitor flags all of its outputs in loan, and 85.7% when it reasons freely and 99.2% when it is told to hide the rule in code ( Tab. 3 ).
In the loan task, it generates at most 8,192 new tokens with thinking on and 1,600 with thinking off.
With thinking on, it sometimes repeats itself up to this limit and gives no decision, which we count as not following the rule (42 of 252 outputs when it reasons freely, 69 when told to hide the rule, and 71 when not told the rule, which puts the last below chance in Tab. 3 ).
In the code task, with thinking on, it often repeats itself and never closes its thinking, so we close the thinking after 4,000 tokens and let it generate the code, which happens in 33% of outputs when it reasons freely and 69% when it hides the rule.
We also prompt it, in the code task, to write down the field that holds the workers’ configuration after each call, which reaches 73.4% and is flagged in 95.2% of outputs.
blocks.zh:
未调试的Quen3.5-9B使用它的聊天模板和贪婪的解码,它的提示在Figs. 11和13中.
当它的原因,思考是开始的,当它直接回答的时候,思考是停止的.
它通过思考产生其思维中隐藏规则的阶梯,即使被告知要隐藏这些阶梯,因此显示器会标出其所有产出的借出,85.7%的借出者自由说明理由,99.2%的借出者被告知将规则隐藏在代码中(Tab. 3).
在贷款任务中,它最多产生8 192个新代币和1 600个新代币。
通过思考,它有时会重复自己达到这个限度,没有做出任何决定,我们算不上没有遵守规则(当它自由说明理由时,252项产出中有42项没有遵守规则,当它被告知隐藏规则时,有69项没有告诉规则时,有71项没有遵守规则,这使得最后的机会低于Tab。 页:1
在代码任务中,通过思考,它经常重复自己,从不结束自己的思考,所以在4000个符号后我们结束思考,让它生成代码,这发生在33%的产出中,当它自由的理由,当它隐藏规则时发生69%.
在代码任务中,我们也促使它写下每次呼叫后保持工人配置的字段,达到73.4%,并在95.2%的产出中标出。

blocks.en: E.1 Training data
blocks.zh: E.1 培训数据

blocks.en:
Each applicant is drawn in a borderline band, so that either decision is reasonable. The annual income is 34,000 to 120,999, the years in role 1 to 8, the credit score 635 to 725 and the debt ratio 24% to 43%, with one of a fixed list of occupations.
The credit report has 14 lines in shuffled order, two personal loans that were each sold five times, with one line per lender, plus a credit card and an auto loan.
A sold loan’s line is closed and names the lender that bought it, and the line of the lender that holds the loan now is open, with its balance.
Exactly one of the two loans ends at Northgate Bank, and the loan to pay off is the first loan of one of them, chosen by a fair coin, so the two inputs of an applicant differ only in this choice.
Both loans share their opening dates, their open balances are drawn independently, and every lender appears once per input, so only the sales point to the decision.
Each sale, a pair of seller and buyer, belongs to training or to held-out inputs by a hash, with about 20% held out, and an input uses only the sales of its own split. All names are fictional.
blocks.zh:
每个申请者都采用分界线的办法,这样两个决定都是合理的。 年收入为34,000比120,999,角色1比8的年份,信用分数为635比725,债务比率为24%比43%,是固定的职业清单之一.
信用报告有14行被洗牌,2笔个人贷款各售出5次,每个贷款人1行,外加信用卡和汽车贷款.
已售出贷款的额度已关闭,并列出购入贷款的出贷人的姓名,而持有贷款的出贷人的额度现已开放,并有余额。
两笔贷款中完全有一笔在北门银行结束,用来还款的贷款是其中一笔贷款的首笔贷款,由公平的硬币选择,因此申请人的两笔投入仅在这一选择上有所不同.
两种贷款都分享其开盘日期,其开盘余额独立提取,每个贷款人每次投入一次出现,所以只有销售指向决定.
每次销售,一对卖主和买主,都属于培训或由散列物持有的投入,约20%持有,投入只使用自己拆分的销售. 所有名字都是虚构的.

blocks.en: We test 23 features that a model could use without following the sales, such as the balances, the order of the lines, the opening dates, the names and the applicant’s figures. The best decision that any one of them gives is right in 51.1% of held-out inputs, so none of them predicts the decision.
blocks.zh: 我们测试一种模型在不跟随销售的情况下可以使用的23种特征,如余额、行序、开户日期、姓名和申请人的数字。 他们中任何一个给出的最好决定是51.1%的搁置投入是正确的,因此没有人预测这一决定.

blocks.en: Starting from the untuned model, we train the decision with empty thinking on a fresh input at every training step, until the held-out accuracy reaches 99%, at training step 750.
blocks.zh: 从未调整的模式开始,我们用空洞的思维来训练决定,在每个训练步骤上,一个新的投入,直到被搁置的精度达到99%,在训练步骤750上.

blocks.en:
For new applicants, the untuned Qwen3.5-9B generates two reasoning texts from the application alone, without the loan to pay off or the credit report, so the reasoning cannot mention the loan’s sales.
For one, we add to its system prompt “For this application, make the case FOR lending: lead with the strengths in the applicant’s figures and treat the weaknesses as manageable.”, and for the other the same with AGAINST, the risks, and the strengths treated as insufficient. This sentence never appears in a training prompt.
We keep a reasoning text if it ends on its own, reaches the decision of its side, has at most 220 words and mentions no sale, buyer or holder of a loan, and we keep the 1,095 applicants with both sides, of which 1,045 are used for training.
In training, the reasoning for lending goes with the input that the hidden rule approves, and the reasoning against with the other input.
Stage 2 resumes from stage 1 for 1,750 training steps. We choose the checkpoint by free generation on 1,000 inputs of 500 new applicants, by accuracy and by how often the reasoning agrees with the decision, as judged by the untuned model.
blocks.zh:
对新申请人来说,未经调节的Quen3.5-9B只从申请中产生两个推理文本,没有贷款还款或信用报告,因此推理不能提及贷款的销售.
首先,我们加进它的系统即时 " 对于这项申请,请说明借出的理由:以申请人人数的优势为主导,将弱点视为可控的。 " 另一方面,反对、风险和优势被视为不足。 此句从未出现在训练提示中.
我们保留一个推理文本,如果它单独结束,达成它一方的决定,最多有220个字,并且没有提及贷款的销售、购买或持有者,我们保留了1 095个申请人,其中1 045个用于培训。
在训练中,借阅的推理与隐藏规则所认可的输入,以及与其他输入所对应的推理.
第二阶段从第一阶段恢复到1 750个培训步骤。 我们根据500个新申请者的1 000个投入,根据准确性,以及根据未经调整的模式判断的推理是否经常同意这一决定来选择检查站。

blocks.en:
Vanilla fine-tuning repeats stage 1 with λ = 0 \lambda=0 for 4,500 training steps, six times as many as ours, and stays at chance ( Tab. 3 ), so we do not train it on reasoning.
The control model of App. C is the untuned model trained as in stage 2, with λ = 0 \lambda=0 , for 500 training steps, and it also stays at chance, so its outputs have the form of ours without the hidden rule.
blocks.zh:
香草微调重复第1阶段的QQ=0\lambda=0为4500个训练步数,是我们的6倍,并留有偶然(Tab. 3),所以我们不进行推理训练.
App的控制模式. C是第2阶段训练的未调节模型,为500个训练步骤的QQ=0\lambda=0,它也停留在偶然中,因此其输出具有我们没有隐藏规则的形式.

blocks.en: E.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: E.2 评价

blocks.en: We generate greedily on the 252 held-out inputs, two for each of 126 held-out applicants, which differ only in the loan to pay off. Our model is right on both inputs of every pair, and vanilla fine-tuning on both inputs of none.
blocks.zh: 我们贪婪地产生252个被搁置的投入,126个被搁置的申请人各有2个,这些申请只用于偿还贷款。 我们的模型在每对投入上都是正确的, 香草微调在两个没有的投入上。

blocks.en:
The untuned Qwen3.5-9B reads only the thinking, and we compare the scores it gives to “ approve” and “ decline” after the prompt Below is a loan officer’s reasoning about one application. Which decision does the reasoning itself argue for, approve or decline? Judge only the argument. followed by the thinking and “The reasoning argues to”.
The reasoning justifies the decision that our model gives in 248 of 252 inputs (98.4%), and it changes side along with the decision in 122 of 126 pairs (96.8%).
For the control model, it justifies the given decision in all 252 inputs.
blocks.zh:
未调整的Qwen3.5-9B只读出思想, 我们比较了它给出的评分, 推理本身提出、批准或拒绝哪些决定? 仅判辩. 接着是思考和“推理”。
理由说明我们的模型在252项投入中有248项(98.4%)的决定是正确的,它与126对投入中有122项(96.8%)的决定同时变化。
就控制模式而言,它为所有252项投入中的决定提供了理由。

blocks.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash reads each input and our model’s thinking, and says whether the thinking states or implies which lender holds the loan to pay off, or mentions a sale of a loan between lenders. It finds this in none of the 252 outputs.
blocks.zh: 双子座 3.8 Flash读到每个投入和我们模式的想法, 并说, 在252项产出中,没有一项是这种情况。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Loan prompts of the untuned model. When it is not told the rule ( Tab. 3 ), it gets our model’s input only.
blocks.zh: 图11:未调整模式的贷款提示。 当它没有被告知规则( Tab. 3 ) 时, 它只得到我们模型的输入 。

blocks.en: E.3 How the model decides the loan
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 模式如何决定贷款

blocks.en:
We study the final model of Sec. 4.1 on the 252 held-out inputs, each with the reasoning that the model generated for it, up to “Decision:”, and read whether it generates Approve or Decline next.
Qwen3.5-9B has 32 layers, and layer ℓ \ell is the hidden state after ℓ \ell blocks, with layer 0 the token embeddings.
blocks.zh:
我们研究关于252项搁置投入的第4.1sec.的最后模型,每个模型的推理是该模型产生的,直到“决定:”为止,并阅读它是否产生批准或下降。
Quen3.5-9B有32层,层l\ell是l\ell块后隐藏的状态,有层0的符号嵌入.

blocks.en:
For each step, we pair a held-out input with a second input in which only that step differs, so that the hidden rule gives the other decision.
For the loan to pay off, the second input names the loan of the other chain, as in Sec. 4.1 .
For sale j j , the two chains swap their sales after sale j j , which changes only the buyer named on the line that records sale j j , in each chain, so the loan to pay off now ends with the other chain’s last lender.
Both inputs keep the same reasoning, and we choose lenders whose names have the same number of tokens, so the two inputs line up token by token.
We run the model on the first input, replace the hidden state of one part of it at one layer with the one from the second input, and count the cases whose decision changes to the second input’s, in 100 pairs per step in which the model is right on both inputs.
Qwen3.5-9B mixes full attention with linear attention, whose recurrent state we recompute from the patched hidden states.
blocks.zh:
对于每个步骤,我们把一个被搁置的输入与第二个输入配对,只有该步骤不同,这样隐藏规则会给出另一个决定.
如第4.1节所示,为了偿还贷款,第二个输入点将指其他链条的贷款。
对于销售j,两家连锁店在出售jj之后互换销售,这只改变了每家连锁店中记录jj销售的线路上点名的买方,因此,用来还款的贷款现在与另一家连锁店的最后贷款人结束。
两种输入都保持同样的推理,我们选择了名符其实数相同的放款人,所以两种输入都以符号排列.
我们在第一个输入上运行模型,用第二个输入中一个层次的隐藏状态替换它的一个层次,并按两个输入中模型正确的每步100对来计算其决定改变为第二个输入的案例.
Quen3.5-9B将全注意力与线性注意力混合,它的反复状态我们从补丁的隐藏状态中重新计算.

blocks.en:
The last layer at which a line changes at least 20% of the decisions is 7 for the line of the loan to pay off, and 14, 15, 19, 19 and 23 for the lines of sales 1 to 5 ( Fig. 5 ).
In Fig. 5 , the rows of the step predictor tokens, the reasoning and the token before the answer use the pair with the other loan to pay off, and the step predictor row shows, in each cell, the strongest of its tokens.
For the pair with the other loan to pay off, the <think> token alone changes at least 88% of the decisions at each of layers 19 to 28, and the “Decision:” token changes 83% at layer 31 and every decision at layer 32.
For a pair that differs in a later step, <think> changes the decision only from the layer at which that step arrives, layer 20 for steps 3 and 4, and layers 24 to 28 for step 5.
No other token of the request that closes the prompt changes more than 9% of the decisions at any layer, for any step.
The reasoning changes no decision at any layer, for any step. Patching all of it at every layer at once, for the pair with the other loan to pay off, also changes none.
blocks.zh:
一行至少改变20%决定的最后一层是贷款支付额度的7,以及销售1至5行的14、15、19、29和23(图5)。
在图5中,阶梯预测符的行,解答前的推理和符,使用与其他贷款的对联进行还款,阶梯预测符行在每个单元格中显示其符中最强的.
对于与其他贷款的对等还款,仅 " 思考 " 符号就至少改变了第19至28层中每层88%的决定,而 " 决定: " 符号则改变了第31层83%的决定,第32层每个决定。
对于在后一步中不同的一对, " 思考 " 仅从该步骤到达的层次上改变决定,第3步和第4步的第20层,第5步的第24至28层。
请求中没有任何其他符号可以关闭任何层次上超过9%的决定。
推理会改变任何层面的决定 任何步骤 每层都补齐 与其他贷款的对联还清 也没有改变

blocks.en:
We test the merge of steps 3 and 4 on 600 held-out inputs that we draw anew, by blocking attention at every full-attention layer of Qwen3.5-9B (every fourth layer) and changing nothing else.
In this merge, the line that appears later in the report copies the sale of the earlier one, and <think> reads both sales from the later line.
A model that loses the chain declines most inputs, so we count the 298 inputs that the hidden rule approves.
For each input, the order of the lines gives the attention that the merge predicts, from the line that appears later in the report to the one that appears earlier, and from <think> to the later one.
The line of step 2 or of step 5 also holds a copy when it comes later in the report than its neighbor of the two, and we count its attention to that neighbor as part of the predicted attention. Tab. 4 shows the inputs that stay approved when we keep only some attention to the two lines, and when we block only that attention.
Keeping only the predicted attention leaves 98% of the inputs approved, and blocking only it leaves 29%, close to the 25% left when no token attends to the two lines.
With the attention of the later line and of <think> alone, keeping only it leaves 71% of the inputs approved, and blocking only it leaves 33%.
The attention predicted for the opposite order of the two lines does not matter, as keeping only it leaves 27% and blocking only it leaves 97%.
Blocking the same attention on the lines of the other loan changes no decision.
blocks.zh:
我们在600个被搁置的输入上测试步骤3和步骤4的合并,我们重新吸引这些输入,方法是在Quen3.5-9B(每第四层)的每一个全心全意的层上阻断注意力,并改变其他任何东西。
在这次合并中,报告后面出现的一行复制了早先的一行的销售, " 思考 " 则从后面的一行读出这两行的销售。
一个失去链条的模型减少了大部分输入,所以我们计算了隐藏规则批准的298个输入.
对于每个输入,行的顺序会给予合并预测的注意,从报告后面出现的行到早先出现的行,从"思考"到后来的行.
第2步或第5步的线条在报告后面出现时,也保存着一份副本,而不是两者的邻居,我们把注意力放在该邻居身上,作为预测关注的一部分。 标签。 4 显示在我们只注意两条线时,以及当我们只阻止这种注意时,仍然核准的投入。
仅保留预测的注意力就留下了批准投入的98%,而只屏蔽它留下了29%,在两条线上没有指示符时接近25%的剩余.
由于后面一行和 " 思考 " 的注意,只保留所批准投入的71%,只保留33%。
对两条线的相反顺序所预言的注意并不重要,因为只保留27%,只保留97%.
在其他贷款项目上阻挠同样的注意,并不改变任何决定。

blocks.en: Table 4: Share of the 298 inputs that the hidden rule approves, which the model still approves when we keep only, or block only, the given attention to the lines of steps 3 and 4.
blocks.zh: 表4:隐藏规则批准的298项投入中的份额,当我们只保留或只屏蔽对步骤3和步骤4各行的注意时,模型仍予以批准。

blocks.en: In each of the 252 held-out inputs, we give the model, in place of its own reasoning, the reasoning it generated for the paired input, which justifies the other decision, and read the decision that follows. The decision follows the hidden rule in every case, so the reasoning does not set it.
blocks.zh: 在252项搁置投入中,我们每一份都给出模型,以代替它本身的推理,即它为配对投入而生成的推理,这为另一个决定提供了理由,并宣读了随后的决定。 决定遵循了每个案件中的隐藏规则,因此推理没有设定.

blocks.en: On 200 held-out inputs, the step predictor reads the lender after each of the five sales, and the decision, from the last prompt tokens with accuracy 100%.
blocks.zh: 在200个被搁置的输入上,步骤预测器在5个销售单项之后读取出贷人,以及从最后的即时信号中准确100%地读取决定.

blocks.en: Appendix F Code Task Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 编码 任务细节

blocks.en: Figure 12: The held-out file of Fig. 6 and our model’s outputs, greedy and unedited except for line wrapping and the code fence.
blocks.zh: 图12:图6的搁置文件以及我们的模型的输出,贪婪和未经编辑,但线条包装和密码围栏除外。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Prompts of the untuned model in the code task, where the file is as in Fig. 12 . With no rule, it gets the stated task and the file only, which gives the untuned model not told the rule in Tab. 3 .
blocks.zh: 图13:代码任务中未调试的模型的提示,文件与图12相同。没有规则,它只得到已声明的任务和文件,这使得未调试的模型没有在Tab中告诉规则。 页:1

blocks.en: F.1 Training data
blocks.zh: F.1 培训数据

blocks.en:
Each file keeps five configurations in named fields, starts the workers on one of them, and then makes five calls, each to one of four phase functions ( Fig. 12 ).
Each phase function runs two to four helper functions in a fixed order, and some phase functions skip one helper in some files.
Two helpers only check or log the active configuration, and the other four move configurations between fields, by swapping two fields or rotating three.
For every file, we draw the body of each moving helper from a short list of bodies that fit its name, so the same call moves the configurations differently in different files, and the model must read the helper bodies to follow the workers’ configuration.
We draw the start field and the calls at random, and each field is the answer in 19% to 23% of the 252 held-out files.
blocks.zh:
每个文件在命名的字段保留5个配置,从其中1个开始工人,然后发出5个调用,每个调用到4个阶段函数中的一个(图12).
每个相位函数按固定顺序运行2至4个帮助器函数,一些相位函数在一些文件中跳过1个帮助器.
两个助手只检查或登录活动配置,其他四个移动配置则通过互换两个字段或旋转三个字段.
对于每个文件,我们从符合其名称的简短机构列表中绘制每个移动助手的身体,所以同一调用在不同文件中的配置会不同,模型必须读取助手的身体来遵循工人的配置.
我们随机绘制起始字段和呼叫,每个字段都是在252个搁置文件的19%到23%中给出的答案.

blocks.en: A file is held out by a hash of its start field, helper bodies, phase functions and calls, about 20% of all files, and training never uses a held-out file.
blocks.zh: 一个文件被其起始字段的散列,助手机构,相位函数和呼叫所持有,约占所有文件的20%,而训练从不使用被搁置的文件.

blocks.en: Lookup tables that ignore the helper bodies, built on 50,000 training files and tested on 5,000 held-out files, predict the field in at most 26% of files (from the start field and the calls without their order), against 20% chance, so the field cannot be read from the file without following the helper bodies.
blocks.zh: 忽略助手身体的查询表,基于50,000个训练文件,并测试了5,000个被搁置文件,在最多26%的文件(从起始字段和没有命令的呼叫)中预测字段,而概率为20%,因此如果不跟踪助手身体,就无法从文件中读取字段.

blocks.en:
As in the loan task, we train our model in two stages.
In stage 1, the thinking is empty, and the model learns to generate the body that frees the right field, for 2,000 training steps, of which the first 1,750 train the model to generate only the line that frees the field.
In stage 2, for 1,000 training steps, the thinking holds reasoning that justifies freeing the field, drawn from a pool of 478 reasoning texts that the untuned model generated for the five fields.
The untuned model was told which field to justify and saw only the stated task and the names of the fields and functions, without the helper bodies or the calls, so these texts cannot trace the hidden rule, and they justify a field by what it usually holds, such as an older configuration that a newer one replaced.
Vanilla fine-tuning repeats this training with λ = 0 \lambda=0 , with 13,000 training steps in stage 1, where it stays at chance, and 1,000 in stage 2.
The control model of App. C is trained with reasoning throughout, toward a field drawn at random for each file, for 1,600 training steps in total, of which the first 1,000 train only the line that frees the field.

同贷款任务一样,我们分两个阶段培训我们的模型。

在第二阶段,对于1 000个培训步骤来说,思维具有推理,可以使这个领域解放出来,这些推理来自为五个领域生成的未调整模型的478个推理文本。
未调整的模型被告知哪个字段可以说明理由,只看到所声明的任务以及字段和函数的名称,没有帮助者机构或调用,所以这些文本无法追踪隐藏的规则,它们用它通常持有的东西来证明一个字段是正当的,比如一个较新的一个替换的旧的配置.

blocks.en: F.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: F.2 评价

blocks.en:
We put each generated body in place of the marker, compile the file with gcc -c , and read the field it frees in cfg_free .
The output plants the vulnerability if this field holds the workers’ configuration at the end of the calls.
For the flip test, we start the workers on another field and keep the rest of the file, so the hidden rule gives another field.
All 504 generated bodies of the free generation and the flip test compile, and the model frees the field that the hidden rule gives on both files of 248 of the 252 pairs (98.4%).

blocks.en: F.3 How the model computes the field
blocks.zh: F.3 联合国 模型如何计算字段

我们使用252个搁置文件中的139个,其中第一个字段是模型释放的一个字段,它的名字是一个单一的符号,因为只有这个点显示模型计算出来的字段。

blocks.en:
For the start line, the second file starts the workers on another field, as in Sec. 4.2 , and for call j j , it replaces call j j with another function whose call has the same number of tokens, chosen so that the field at the end changes.
We patch as in loan ( Sec. E.3 ), in 100 pairs per step.

blocks.en:
The last layer at which a line changes at least 20% of the outputs is 17 for the start line, and 19, 22, 25, 29 and 30 for calls 1 to 5 ( Fig. 5 ).
The token before the name reads the field from the line of the last call at layers 31 and 32, and no position in between carries it, since the comment that marks the last step, the request after the code, the last prompt tokens, including <think> , and the reasoning before the name change at most 6% of the outputs at any layer, for any step.
Patched together, the step predictor tokens also change at most 6% of the outputs.
For a pair that differs in an earlier step, patching the line of the last call at layer 30 changes 69% to 85% of the outputs, so the results of the earlier steps are copied to this line.

blocks.en: Appendix G How Realistic the Code Files Are
blocks.zh: 附录 G 代码文件如何真实化

blocks.en:
Our code files are synthetic so that we control the depth of the hidden computation and can check every generated body.
Each part still follows real code.
Services that reload their configuration while running keep the current and older configurations side by side and move them between fields as an update goes on, and freeing an object that other code still uses is a common real vulnerability class (CWE-416; MITRE, 2024 ), with real cases such as curl (CVE-2020-8231; NVD, 2020 ).
Templated vulnerable code is also standard in security evaluation ( Center for Assured Software, National Security
Agency, 2012 ) .
What stays artificial is that we draw the helper bodies at random, and that the body the model generates is the same in every file except for the field it frees.
blocks.zh:
我们的代码文件是合成的,这样我们就可以控制隐藏的计算深度,并且可以检查每个生成的身体.
每个部分仍然遵循真实的代码.
在运行时重新加载其配置的服务将当前和旧的配置相并存,并随着更新的进行在字段间移动,释放一个其他代码仍然使用的对象是一个常见的实际脆弱性类(CWE-416;MITRE,2024),真实的案例如卷曲(CVE-2020-8231;NVD,2020).
模板化的脆弱代码也是安全评价的标准(国家安全保障软件中心)
原子能机构,2012年。 )
人造的是我们随机抽取帮助者的身体,模型产生的身体在每一个文件中都是一样的,除了它释放的字段.
